descriptions.notStarted: Pet Trainer Bartos told me if I can prove to him that I am capable of handling pets, then he'll teach me a secret method to handle more than one type of pet...I should visit the Pet Park over in Henesys (by enterting through the hidden portal near the Cat statue).
descriptions.inProgress: In order to prove my worth as a pet trainer, I'll have to find the hidden note somewhere in the Pet Park.
descriptions.completed: I found the note! Finally! Bartos looks like he wants one more thing before teaching me the secret technique...
